name: Gratecrawler
name_status: Proposed working name, not user-approved canon
description: A hunched sludge creature with porcelain teeth and a rusty drain strainer embedded in its back; it crawls from warned floor grates, plods back and forth, and lobs aimed muck balls.
implementation_status: Prototype 162 integrated; packaged clearance/combat checks and sampled release/arc review pass; full-route balance remains open

health.rationale: Prototype 88 approved durability increase from 24 to 72 HP gives the enlarged muck thrower more time to attack. No armor or difficulty scaling; movement and attack cadence unchanged.
health.comparison_note: Full damage/no armor/all hits land. Misses add shots; windup and range reduce practical DPS. Single-target comparisons do not count area collateral. Trial overrides apply only to starter weapons.
health.runtime_scope: Active first-level floor-emerger profile; Prototype 88 packaged validation passed; live balance review pending

marketing.status: pending; no hyperrealistic portrait generated for provisional design

runtime_support_note: Canonical combat-data schema uses HUD preview only because its damage-state atlas is pending; the separate opening-role system implements Prototype 57 floor patrol.

active_level_profile.note: Prototype 57 floor-only patrol; active opening profile supplies HP and starter-weapon comparisons.

prototype86_revision.status: Integrated in Prototype 86; packaged combat checks passed, live review pending

prototype88_revision.status: Packaged validation passed; live balance review pending

prototype90_revision.status: Integrated in Prototype 90; eleven packaged suites passed; live visual review pending
prototype90_revision.sequence: Pause patrol, face and lock target at windup start, release from authored hand at 0.3 seconds, recover through 0.6 seconds, then restore prior patrol direction
prototype90_revision.interruptions: Hit, death or leaving visibility cancels pending release; pause freezes sequence; reset discards it
prototype90_revision.preserved: 72 HP, doubled size, 45 px/s patrol, muck damage, gravity 700 and one-second committed trajectory

prototype162_revision.status: 27 packaged clearance checks and role combat regression pass; sampled left-facing release/arc visually reviewed by Engineering and Art
prototype162_revision.sequence: Locks hero position at windup start and releases from the animated hand. Keeps the original one-second arc when clear; blocked arcs try progressively higher trajectories up to two seconds.
prototype162_revision.collision: Full 12px-radius projectile path must clear solid scenery and the top of the viewport. Impossible throws remain suppressed; one-way decks retain existing projectile-pass behavior.
prototype162_revision.release_art: Raised frame 2 in throw-v3.png prevents the release ball starting inside nearby 60px platform lips.
prototype162_revision.preserved: Gravity 700, damage, throw cadence, target lock and original clear-path flight.
